observationsAndLimits: Unix reason trace demonstrates that handler reached its trace site; it does not prove a Windows callback completed
sending WM_QUERYENDSESSION plus results establishes exact observed windows/responses; missing response is unknown
finished WM_ENDSESSION and giving quit reply establish driver callback progress for only the recorded process/window set
terminating process trace is before the installed TerminateProcess call and proves branch entry, not syscall success or a numerical process wait status

Managed quitting/destroy rows are their own observations; their absence does not establish callback suppression or a source exception
